title: top-team-sync-rapid-asks
notes:
Purpose: quick briefing for the top-team weekly sync, focused items where a decision or an explicit ask is needed during the 30m slot. This is a working scratchpad — concise context + desired outcome + ask.

Meeting logistics:
- Time: 30 minutes (tight) — allocate 6 min per item + 6 min buffer/parking.
- Attendees: CEO, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Infra, Head of Customer Success, me (ops).
- Prep: bring answers on capacity, commit terms, and cost delta for proposed fallback.

Agenda & rapid asks:
1) Dedicated capacity renewal (6m)
   Context: Large customer (FinReg Inc) signals they want to move to Dedicated to meet data residency + SLA. Current commit template has 12-month minimum. Sales requests a 6-month pilot with billing parity.
   Desired outcome: decide on offering a 6-month trial with pro-rated pricing or insist on 12-month.
   Ask for meeting: Approve a standardized 6-month pilot variant for compliance-limited accounts (if execs agree, product + finance to craft contract).

2) Canary fallback behavior after regional GPU shortage (6m)
   Context: Last week we had an autoscaler race in us-west that caused ~8% tail-latency spikes. Ops implemented temporary fallback to smaller quantized model; no customer-facing outage but quality degraded for some routes.
   Desired outcome: authorize a permanent, opt-in per-customer policy for automated model-fallback with a clear SLO downgrade notice.
   Ask: Approve policy principle (opt-in) and require product to expose a toggle + cost delta estimate by EOW.

3) Cost-optimization quick wins from Optimize pilot (6m)
   Context: Pilot on caching+batching reduced per-token infra cost by ~12% on steady-state; memory pressure increased in peak windows.
   Desired outcome: greenlight staged rollout to 20% of host-api traffic for 4 weeks.
   Ask: Approve rollout guardrails: canary on non-critical routes, alerting thresholds, and rollback authority to SRE on signal.

4) Exec-level hiring ask (6m)
   Context: SRE head recommends one Senior SRE (+1 IC) to stabilize cross-region failovers before Q3 expansion. Recruit cycle ~10 weeks.
   Desired outcome: signoff to open role and reallocate $220k from hiring bench.
   Ask: Approve headcount and expedited interview plan; confirm hiring panel.

5) Customer incident follow-up (6m)
   Context: FinReg experienced higher error rate for embeddings route during the fallback. CS proposes proactive credits + postmortem.
   Desired outcome: agree compensation band and finalize postmortem distribution cadence (internal + customer-facing).
   Ask: Authorize up to $25k in credits for that account and approve the postmortem draft timeline.

Rapid data pointers (pull these numbers live):
- 95p latency us-west for text-gen: 420ms -> 456ms last week (+8.6% MoM).
- Optimize pilot cost delta: -12% infra tokens, +3% peak memory utilization.
- Dedicated pipeline capacity: 320 sustained rps per 8-GPU pool.

Decisions to capture (post-meeting):
- Pilot 6-month Dedicated template? (Yes/No + conditions)
- Approve opt-in auto-fallback policy? (Yes/No + rollout timeline)
- Can we proceed with Optimize 20% rollout? (Yes/No + stop criteria)
- Headcount approval? (Yes/No)
- Customer credit authorization? (Yes/No + amount)

Action items (owner / due):
- Marco Li: draft 6-month pilot contract template for review (due 2026-03-17).
- Aisha Khan: spec for opt-in fallback toggle + UX copy (due 2026-03-12).
- Infra team (ops): implement canary + alerting for Optimize rollout (due 2026-03-20).
- SRE hiring lead: open req and identify hiring panel (due 2026-03-14).
- CS Lead: prepare customer compensation proposal and postmortem outline (due 2026-03-11).

Risks / notes to call out if pressed:
- Short pilots increase churn risk if pricing not nailed; finance should simulate worst-case.
- Auto-fallback without clear customer opt-in could cause quiet regressions in model output quality and blame; need explicit notice and SLAs.
- Optimize rollout may surface memory regressions on tails; must have kill-switch.

Parking lot (only if time remains):
- Discuss audit retention request from legal for Private customers.
- Quick read: draft marketplace listing updates for Dedicated (marketing wants sign-off).

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Keep language simple: present 3 crisp tradeoffs per item.
- If we run out of time, prioritize Dedicated pilot decision and fallback policy.
- Bring the customer email thread (FinReg) + incident timeline into meeting.

Bottom line for execs: two fast decisions unlock our enterprise push this month — (1) provide a shorter Dedicated pilot path for regulated customers, and (2) formalize opt-in fallback to keep SLAs intact during capacity events. Both have clear product and finance follow-ups; ask execs to rubber-stamp principles, not final contracts.
